an5.146:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammamehi samannāgato bhikkhumitto na sevitabbo.
an5.146:1.3: kammantaṃ kāreti, adhikaraṇaṃ adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyati, pāmokkhesu bhikkhūsu paṭiviruddho hoti, dīghacārikaṃ anavatthitacārikaṃ anuyutto viharati, na paṭibalo hoti kālena kālaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ.
an5.146:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhumitto na sevitabbo.
an5.146:2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhumitto, sevitabbo.
an5.146:2.3: na kammantaṃ kāreti, na adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyati, na pāmokkhesu bhikkhusu paṭiviruddho hoti, na dīghacārikaṃ anavatthitacārikaṃ anuyutto viharati, paṭibalo hoti kālena kālaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ.
an5.146:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhumitto sevitabboti.
